annotations.title: Read a company's website for the scan

description: Step one of a scan: read the company's website and return the scan form's steps, pre-filled with what we read. Call this first, walk the user through `steps` in order, show them the answers and the queries, and get a yes before calling scan_ai_visibility. Every value is a guess from the website (or, for a signed-in workspace's returning brand, what the brand already holds) for the user to confirm or correct. Returns brand_name, steps (each with title and fields: param, question, help, kind, options, value, suggestions), scan (engines, queries_per_engine, queries_total) and how_to_ask.
